name: metadata-transformer
description: Node.js lambda for transforming item metadata using AWS Bedrock

scripts.prepare-dist: mkdir -p dist && cp -r src package.json dist/
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run prepare-dist && npm run install-prod && npm run package && echo "Lambda package is at: $(pwd)/lambda.zip" && echo "Lambda size: $(du -h lambda.zip | cut -f1)"
